description: Parcel v1 rejection vectors (docs/parcel.md). Every receiver must reject each manifest JSON (hex bytes) and each parcel with the given reason. Parcels use the vectors' link secret, sequence 0 and salt; a parcel with `expectedDigest` is received by a recipient that already pinned that contract digest for sequence 0.

manifests.name: media type with a line break

parcels.name: a byte after the last record
another contract under a header that is byte-identical to the pinned one
flipped synthetic prefix of manifest record 0
nonce that is not synthetic, with a matching label
manifest stream longer than the minimal power of two
contract record count that does not match the manifest
label page that does not belong to the root
record that differs from its label (breach)
